name: Sukusuku Mizugi ~Nusunda Mizugi wa Karukishuu~
original_name: すくすく水着 盗んだ水着はカルキ臭
source:
Tamafumi is a university student. One day, he is asked to work part-time as a pool guard at girls' high school. He accepts the offer, but he is a little bit concerned.... When he was a kid, he was mistakenly stigmatized as a swimwear thief. On his first day at school, he meets Sakura and Chika, members of the swimming club and Sakura says to him, "Did you belong to the swimming club of Uzushio High School?" Actually, Tamafumi was a famous swimmer when he was a high school student. Sakura and Chika ask him to give them a lesson. He doesn't want it, but he finally accepts it...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305064220/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_45/products_id/1010777]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
Tamafumi是一名大学生。一天，他受邀前往女子高中兼职担任泳池管理员。他接受了工作，却有些担忧…小时候，他曾被误认为泳衣窃贼，背上污名。上班第一天，他遇见游泳部成员Sakura和Chika，Sakura问他：“你以前是不是漩潮高中的游泳部成员？”实际上，Tamafumi高中时曾是一名著名游泳选手。Sakura和Chika请求他指导训练。他本不愿答应，最后还是接受了…
